name: Tamsyn Sweene
description: A shapeshifting Dimir spy who poses as a blastseeker to infiltrate Leighbet's lab and steal her serum, then tries to kill her.

timeline.summary: Leighbet hires Tamsyn Sweene as a blastseeker, who claims past experience and passes a practical test.
timeline.quote: Tamsyn Sweene. Call me Tammy, and we've got a problem.

timeline.summary: Their serum, made from rift plant samples, makes a lab mouse completely impervious to electricity.
Tamsyn tells a false story of her chemister's death and talks Leighbet into hiring her by promising to get the lab approved without sanctions.
timeline.quote: I can get your lab declared an Innovative Niche Workshop.

timeline.summary: Tamsyn gets the lab officially recognized by the Izmundi and recruits five paid test subjects, and the serum protects all of them from electric shocks.
timeline.quote: The other four tests go exactly the same, successes all around.

timeline.summary: Tamsyn convinces Leighbet that the test subjects must be silenced and poisons all five with a lethal sleep elixir, and Leighbet goes along with it.
timeline.quote: I already gave them all a hyper-concentrated dose of sleep elixir laced with an ethereal death accelerant.

timeline.summary: Tamsyn finds Leighbet in the sewers and reveals she is a shapeshifting Dimir spy who never was a blastseeker.
timeline.quote: There was no chemister, Leighbet. I never was a blastseeker.

timeline.summary: Tamsyn attacks Leighbet with electricity and declares the serum a Dimir discovery; an arc drake's electric breath hits them in the water.
timeline.quote: your serum is a Dimir discovery now. Goodbye, Leighbet.

timeline.summary: Leighbet builds a makeshift ballast from sewer junk, stuns Tamsyn with a thrown welding jar and redirects her own blast back at her.
timeline.quote: When the next blast orb comes, I meet it with my makeshift ballast.

timeline.summary: Leighbet's Simic transformation wears off, and she kills Tamsyn by snapping her spine to keep the discovery from Dimir.
timeline.quote: as Tamsyn's vertebrae snap, I take comfort that she doesn't know pain for long.

relations.note: She breaks Tamsyn's neck in the sewers.
relations.quote: as Tamsyn's vertebrae snap, I take comfort that she doesn't know pain for long.

relations.note: She reveals she is a Dimir spy.
She tries to kill Leighbet and steal her serum.
relations.quote: A mind like yours is a terrible thing to waste
